page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz, accompanied by 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The processor includes 35 MB of L3 cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 KB of L1d cache. This instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage and baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Benchmark data places this server in the average performance tier across multiple workloads. In CPU-intensive tasks, it achieves a stress-ng multi-core score of 30666.35 and a single-core score of 1436.68. Cryptographic and vector operations are supported by hardware-accelerated instructions, including AVX-512 and AES, yielding a PassMark CPU extended instructions score of 28691.75 and an encryption test score of 14168.84. Memory performance is characterized by a read-only small block cached bandwidth of 1705.41 GB/sec, which drops to 109.89 GB/sec for uncached large blocks.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation and 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.hfg6.8xlarge offers a balanced resource density suitable for general-purpose enterprise workloads. It demonstrates strong capabilities in database operations, scoring 11442.59 on PassMark database tests, and handles up to 28.91 million Redis SET operations per second. It is also capable of handling software compilation and moderate LLM inference, processing 45.98 prompt tokens per second on a 7B model. The lack of local storage requires external block storage, which should be factored into the overall architectural cost efficiency.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.8xlarge is an x86_64 general-purpose server powered by a 3.1 GHz Intel Xeon 8269CY processor with 32 dedicated physical cores and 128.0 GB of RAM. It features a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, 35 MB of L3 cache, and a 10 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, though it lacks local storage and GPU accelerators. Performance benchmarks place this instance in the average tier, with a stress-ng multi-core score of 30666.35 and a PassMark CPU score of 29517.51. It supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and AES, enabling efficient cryptographic and vector processing. The server is well-suited for multi-threaded applications, software compilation, database operations, and static web serving, offering a stable and dedicated compute environment for enterprise workloads.
